message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine crimes based on facts. The case: Su (defendant) engaged in fraudulent scheme: He pretended to supply cement, got money from Wang (investor) under false pretenses, used money to pay debts, provided fake delivery notes. This is fraud (诈骗) – specifically contract fraud, false business transaction, obtaining money by deception. Also forging documents (伪造发货单) – forging company documents, which is crime of forging business documents (伪造、变造、买卖国家机关公文、证件、印章?) Actually forging commercial documents (发货单) – could be "伪造公司印章、证件" but typical Chinese criminal law includes "伪造、变造、买卖国家机关公文、证件、印章" (for state documents). For private company documents, maybe "诈骗" covers using false documents. Also "非法占有" of money. Could be "诈骗罪" and "伪造公司印章、证件罪"? The examples earlier: For forging documents they used "伪造、变造、买卖国家机关公文、证件、印章". But here the forged documents are from a private company (怀宁海螺水泥有限公司). That might be "伪造、变造公司印章、证件" which is not listed. In Chinese criminal law, there is crime of "伪造、变造、买卖国家机关公文、证件、印章" (Article 280). It applies to state documents. For private, there is "诈骗" using false documents. So likely only "诈骗". Also maybe "非法占有" but that's part of fraud. Also "挪用资金"? He used the money for personal debts, but that is still fraud.

Thus answer: 诈骗.
